reviewContext.issueReference: round-6-audit:feat/ai-capture@6f58a74f717475d515122570804c9a63a7fd6bb8 (base 0a35708) plus uncommitted round 5 fixes; no GitHub issue; workflowInput.requestedOutcome is the issue body
reviewContext.userProblem: The round-6 audit found four defects in 3D CAD pages and AI capture: capture and cad check print diagnostic ids shortened to tokens such as name:a that the edit command reads as label or batch selectors, so reusing a printed token deletes an unrelated element; a dense-mesh scan that stops during the coarse interference pass is reported as a checked pair with only a sub-cell warning and --fail-on-interference exits 0; the round 5 scan allowance still admits billions of mesh triangle visits per capture because it never runs out below 1,024 entries per ray; and desktop export drops the not-sampled notice for bodies whose census is unknown.
requiredOutcomes: function-capture-diagnostic-selector-prefix (R6-1; f1): shortIds maps ids starting with name: or @ to the full id; tokens taken from capture stdout (structural and sampled) delete the failed feature and keep the competing labelled or batch-referenced element; cad check prints the full id; JSON keeps full ids.

function-capture-coarse-scan-reported-as-refinement (R6-2; f2a, f2b, f2c, f4): coverage from successful level-0 casts; cast coarse hits preserved on exhaustion; analysis.incomplete (subset of cappedWithoutHit, key only when non-empty); text, CLI JSON and desktop show incomplete without calling a pictured overlap unknown; --fail-on-interference exits 1; refinement-only caps unchanged; 1 vs 5 threads identical; native release-CLI cropped dense case exits 1.

performance-interference-mesh-triangle-scans (R6-3; f3): request-wide triangle-entry ceiling R = 32 x B (64 fallback) split analysis R/2 (shares assigned before dispatch), visible census R/4, hidden census R/8, picture-only pairs R/8; prism edges not charged; four-phase triangle measurement with finisher and never-settling census bodies; prism-only control pinned; 1 vs 5 threads identical; existing pins unchanged.

maintainability-desktop-omits-incomplete-body-census (R6-4; f4): describeBodies.notSampled lists every unknown body; desktop note names them including after position eight; no cad.result.empty for unknown bodies; same report through CLI and desktop.
nonGoals: No golden regeneration, no NCS1 change, no error code change, no change to existing messages when the new states are absent.
No edits to crates/capture/src/mesh.rs, prism.rs, raster.rs, raster/**, lib.rs; no edit to apps/cli/src/edit/selectors.ts, edit/batch.ts, capture-cad.ts or cad-command.ts.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, strict typing, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, rustfmt on touched Rust files.
Each plan uses its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR (target/car6-f3, target/car6-f2a, target/car6-f2c) and artifactRoots ["target", "tmp/cad3d"].
Per-plan gates are focused; typecheck, lint, mise run verify and the full native capture suite run once at integration.
Timing failures: at most three full-gate attempts, then one exact single-test isolated run (--lib tiles::tests::<name> -- --exact --nocapture); both reported separately; deadlines never relaxed.

designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The audited formatter; every consumer inherits a resolvable token; exact-id-first resolver needs no grammar change.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R6-2 coverage from successful level-0 casts with witness preservation; incomplete as a subset list emitted only when non-empty.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Separates unprobed grids from refinement-only exhaustion, keeps observed overlaps and leaves every existing report byte-identical.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R6-2 two incomplete wordings depending on a same-pair record.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A pictured overlap is never described as unknown.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: R6-3 ceiling counts mesh triangle entries only with fixed phase fractions.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Bounds the finding's triangle scans without truncating prism-only scenes; no plumbing between phases.
Desktop gets every name, not the eight-name summary.

intentionalTradeoffs: R6-3 caps mesh pairs or census bodies above their share (capped, incomplete or unknown, never a wrong claim).
R6-2 witness preservation may turn an exhausted capped miss into a capped approximate hit.
supportedEdgeCases: Ids starting with name: or @, sampled and structural diagnostics, picture-only pairs for incomplete candidates, refinement-only exhaustion after the final coarse cast, exhaustion during row preload, per-body census allowance carry-over, prism-only dense scenes, unknown bodies after position eight.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Native elapsed-time limits for the worst case at the new ceiling; Tauri IPC and MCP delivery.
